Directions: Refer to the following excerpt, then answer each question that follows.
Content: “What is the phenomenon of globalization . . . ? Fundamentally, it is the closer integration of the countries and peoples of the world which has been brought about by the enormous reduction of costs of transportation . . . and the breaking down of artificial barriers to the flow of goods, services, capital, knowledge, and (to a lesser extent) people across borders.”
